request.prompt: Create one production candidate bitmap for the Armax Relay Clash 2D fighting-game art catalog, faithfully studying the supplied original game-model reference. A single full-body subject only, isolated on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, no scenery, no floor plane or ground shadow, no lettering, no caption, no border, no diagram, no contact sheet, no repeated views, no logo added outside the subject. Clean readable silhouette, detailed realistic game-model materials, restrained neutral studio illumination. Show a three-quarter front view with the subject oriented toward screen-right, camera level and minimal perspective distortion. The complete head, equipment, limbs and feet must fit; leave at least six percent transparent breathing room on every side. Preserve the reference's real anatomy, panel construction, proportions, asymmetric equipment and exact costume palette. Do not redesign or modernize. Subject: the Cerberus Guardian from Mass Effect 3, as the two full-body views in the reference. One armored human soldier, stocky heavy white and weathered light-grey shell armor over black technical underlayers, mustard-yellow limited stripes and inserts. The unique dark dome respirator helmet sits within a tall armored collar, with narrow diagonal red optical slits, black circular breathing fittings and an overhead rectangular curved carry bar. Reproduce the stepped white thigh plates, black hip straps, knee and shin segments and broad armored boots. Large broad worn white ballistic riot shield attached to the ANATOMICAL LEFT arm, with its distinctive upper horizontal viewing slot, stepped angular upper edge, long yellow diagonal/edge stripe, dark Cerberus marking and tiny red lights. Keep the shield front facing readable, protectively in front and to the side of the torso, not edge-on; knees and feet still visible below it. A compact pistol from the reference is held low in the ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand, pointed down and clear of the shield, no firing. A grounded slight combat-ready stance, both feet fully visible. Do not mirror the arm assignments. Preserve the proportions and shield construction in the reference, without adding oversized spikes, cape, new armor or decorative lights.
